#Module entries

The File and Directory Entries API for what the user dropped (src/page/dnd_entries.odin; native/js/runtime/web_entries.c): DataTransferItem.webkitGetAsEntry() gives a FileSystemFileEntry or a FileSystemDirectoryEntry for a dropped file or folder; a folder is listed lazily, one directory at a time, on a background thread (createReader().readEntries()), and its files are opened the same way (file()). Paths stay inside what was dropped: a path that leaves it ("..") is refused.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/js_entries.widl.

#FsEntry_lookup
